feedback: Format check passes: REWARD_MACHINE, STATES, INITIAL_STATE, FINAL_STATES, TRANSITION_FUNCTION and REWARD_FUNCTION are all present in the paper layout; FINAL_STATES: u3 is nonempty, declared in STATES, and accepting, since u3 is entered exactly on target_picked_up (the episode terminal) and is absorbing thereafter. Semantic fidelity: the chain has_door_key -> u1 -> door_open -> u2 -> target_picked_up -> u3 matches the task ordering (take the key, open the door with it, finally the box), and the first clause is enforced structurally: from u1 the only route to the final state runs through door_open, so an episode that takes the key and never opens the door ends in u1 with no final reward. key_lost is used per its event reading: the (u1, key_lost) self-loop with -0.1 fires once per drop before the door opens, and recovery is preserved because the state stays u1, so re-picking the key and toggling still reaches u2; this matches the opened-afterwards reading that permits drop-and-reacquire, and the task-required drop happens with the door open so it is never penalized. Reward safety: progress rewards are dense and monotone (0.1 < 0.2 < 1.0) and bounded; the only repeatable term is the -0.1 deterrent, and there is no incentive inversion since satisfying trajectories score at least 1.2 while key-taken-never-opened endings score at most 0.1. No farming: the u1 else-loop absorbs has_door_key re-acquisition without a duplicate +0.1, and u2 leaves door_open re-fires to else instead of re-rewarding toggles; no regression on the door closing is required because the task does not demand the door stay open (the environment enforces openness at pickup and the door is never relocked). Coverage and reachability: every state has exactly one else self-loop covering irrelevant events; given the domain constraints each ordered event can first occur only in its designated state, so no first occurrence is missed; all states and the final state are reachable; four states is compact with no redundant states. Labels are predicate-only (the four domain propositions plus else). Minor residual, not disqualifying: a degenerate trajectory that closes the opened door, re-grabs the key and finishes with the door closed violates the letter of the first clause but is indistinguishable with single-proposition labels (it would need has_door_key and not door_open in u2); leaving (u2, key_lost) to else is the right call because key_lost in u2 also occurs in satisfying trajectories.

feedback: Accepted. The function set exactly matches the four environment-declared propositions (has_door_key, door_open, target_picked_up, key_lost) with no undeclared extras and no missing predicates. has_door_key, door_open, and target_picked_up are character-for-character equivalent to the documented truth conditions: guarded carrying check with key/door color matching, a guarded grid scan for an open door, and the mission-string match 'pick up the {color} box' against env.mission. key_lost correctly implements the documented event semantics: it reads env.episode_memory['previous_valuation']['has_door_key'] read-only, negates the full has_door_key conjunction, and requires the door not currently open, so it fires only on the single step after a key drop with the door still closed and never co-occurs with has_door_key, door_open, or target_picked_up. All attribute accesses (env.carrying.type/color, cell.type/is_open/color, env.mission, env.width/height, env.grid.get) are within the documented API scope; empty cells are guarded with 'is not None' before attribute reads; is_open and color are only read after confirming type. The code is syntactically valid Python, performs no imports, no actions, and no mutations of env or episode_memory; persistent propositions read only current state and the event only compares against the read-only previous valuation. The initial truthiness guard on previous_valuation is harmless since the memory always holds a complete valuation with all propositions false at the first step.
